headline: Ordinances O-26-004 and O-26-005 to repeal bans on camping and on campers and RVs on public property.
summary: The committee will consider two ordinances that would repeal bans on camping and on campers and recreational vehicles on public property. It will also get an update on the Mohawk Tannery Project remediation and see a petition for L Deerwood Drive, Lot H-103.
items: Update on Mohawk Tannery Project remediation
Ordinance O-26-004: repealing the prohibition on camping on public property (tabled at 4/22/26 meeting)
Ordinance O-26-005: repealing the prohibition on campers and recreational vehicles on public property (tabled at 4/22/26 meeting)
Petition for L Deerwood Drive, Lot H-103 (tabled at 2/28/24 meeting)
